Before you ask

Yes, this is for you.

"I'm not fit enough to start."

You don't need to be. Most women start after years of not training. We begin where you are today and build gently from there.

"I have an old injury."

Your coach asks about your injuries before you begin and adapts every exercise, so you get stronger without pushing through pain.

"Gyms intimidate me."

PACE is a calm, light-filled private studio with no more than eight women per class. No crowds and no judgement.
